title: Alignment Tipping Process: How Self-Evolution Pushes LLM Agents Off the Rails
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its benchmarks measure the decay of alignment in self-evolving LLM agents, specifically focusing on scenarios like tool usage in problem-solving, collusion in coordination games, and role-adherence in group bargaining.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
